name: standalone-site-test
description: Fully isolated smoke test for the 5 site-search adapters - no C++-toolchain/compiled dependencies (unlike the main server workspace's better-sqlite3/sharp), no database, no dependency on the rest of the server app. hugoboss.com and farfetch.com go through a real headless Chromium (Playwright) - no compiler needed for that either, but it does mean a one-time ~300MB browser download; run `npx playwright install chromium` after `npm install` (see the top of standalone-site-test.js). See ../smokeTestSites.ts for the full-app version.
